summary: The filing is a Form 6-K press release announcing that BW LPG shares trade ex-dividend on the Oslo Stock Exchange on June 11, 2026 and on the NYSE on June 12, 2026. The cash dividend for Q1 2026 is NOK 6.1960 per share and US$0.67 per share. No special situation is present as this is a routine dividend announcement with no acquisition, divestiture, tender, or strategic change.
